alt: 孩子與家人在公園池畔欣賞水中花枝和明月的倒影，落葉泛起漣漪，映像隨之破碎。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 鏡花水月 means a beautiful but unreal or unattainable illusion. A child kneels safely on a wide paved pond edge in a modern botanical garden, reaching toward the clear reflection of a flowering branch and bright full moon on still water. A tiny ripple from a floating leaf gently distorts the reflection, reminding the viewer it is only an image in water. Real flower branch and actual moon are visible above the water, while their mirrored counterparts are delicate and unreachable below. Keep child well back from water, one adult nearby, no dangerous leaning. Natural anatomy, hands, grounded knees and shoes, believable water reflection and ripple. No text.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary park at dusk. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper; restrained natural colors, no digital 3D.
